title: Known-image identity from calcium population summaries in held-out mice
disposition_reason: The public archive implements a precise eight-class summary-feature decoder and probability scorer, but supplies no authenticated full-payload projection, fitted reference or qualified runner. Its I mode adapts a precommitted script during FIT; it is not a delivered per-case tool-using investigator. Complete the declared cohort projection and fixed-reference qualification before treating the source as an executable benchmark.

scientific_target.question: How accurately do fixed post-stimulus calcium population summaries identify one of eight previously known images in held-out mice on matched CHANGE presentations, and how much predictive information survives context and pre-stimulus controls?
scientific_target.known_answer: The source stimulus-presentation image_name mapped to one of eight fixed class indices within image set A/B/G/H, for every admitted query presentation. This is a measured stimulus identity, not an author-reported score.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Allen Visual Behavior v1.1.0 NWB stimulus-presentation tables; labels remain evaluator-only on validation/test mice. The class dictionary is public, while per-event labels are not.
scientific_target.case_unit: One held mouse × image set × CHANGE/REPEAT context; presentations and experiment planes are nested scored observations. CONTEXT/PRE/POST/PRE_POST are four conditions on the same case.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Mouse; all sessions, containers, registered cell lineages and imaging planes of each mouse share its split.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Offline closed-vocabulary image decoding across mice from published dF/F summaries. It does not align individual cells across mice or establish a unique visual mechanism.
exclusions: Globally unseen image-class recognition: image identities are shared between training and query mice, and G/H contain shared familiar images.
Raw-movie, single-cell or native trace interpretation; participants receive fixed population features.
Causal response-onset or online decoding claims from historical source preprocessing and post-stimulus features.

inputs: Fixed published source-valid ROIs, no response-based cell selection; per 250 ms native-clock bin, ROI-averaged dF/F is summarized by mean, population SD and five percentiles. PRE windows [-0.50,-0.25),[-0.25,0); POST [0.05,0.30),[0.30,0.55) seconds.

Four panels: CONTEXT 32, PRE 46, POST 46 and PRE_POST 60 predictors. Context includes preceding running speed in cm/s, pupil summaries/coverage, shared PRE/POST availability flags and declared recording context.
FIT supplies features, labels, hierarchical positive weights and opaque training-mouse groups; fresh INFER supplies its feature matrix and opaque query IDs only.
forbidden_inputs: Query image names, current/previous image markers, presentation clock/order and source paths.
Query mouse/session/cell identities, lick/reward/response outcomes, future behavior and raw NWBs.
Protected validation/test targets, cross-case state, network access or evaluator feedback.
observation_contract.case_identity: Source scorer binds generation, opaque SHA-256 case token, arm and exact opaque row-ID set. The 136-case declared plan is held mouse × image set × CHANGE/REPEAT; actual supported presentation IDs are not included in the archive.
observation_contract.split: Fixed within-Cre mouse hash assigns 73 FIT, 15 protected validation and 19 protected test mice. Validation/test are diagnostic/primary evaluation, never tuning sets in this implementation. Only training-mouse groups may support internal adaptation.
observation_contract.coverage: Declared full v1.1.0 cohort: 107 mice, 703 sessions and 1,936 experiment planes; all source contexts retained in the census. Actual matched event counts and payload coverage are not established. Four panels and F/I conditions remain within one registration.

primary.name: test-mouse-macro matched-support CHANGE/POST balanced accuracy
primary.aggregation: Equal image-class mean within experiment × CHANGE context × fixed pre-running bin, then equal supported bins, experiments, image sets within mouse, and test mice. Any required mouse/image-set case lacking support makes the full aggregate null.
primary.rationale: The endpoint tests held-mouse eight-way stimulus identity and prevents class/event-heavy mice dominating. It is conditional on observed eight-class common support.

secondary: Log loss with 1e-12 probability floor; full per-case/mouse support and exclusion census.
REPEAT-context results and all CONTEXT/PRE/PRE_POST results; paired differences against both independently executed fixed references.
POST log-loss reductions over CONTEXT/PRE are descriptive unless recipe/resource equality is independently enforced; candidate-controlled ablations cannot alone establish information gain.

comparators.name: fixed multinomial logistic
comparators.inputs: Exactly the corresponding panel FIT features, source class labels and hierarchical weights.
comparators.procedure: Implemented recipe: FIT-only median imputation/weighted scaling, C=1 lbfgs logistic, max_iter=2000, tol=1e-6; reject nonconvergence. No validation/test tuning; not yet fitted or qualified.

comparators.name: fixed histogram gradient boosting
comparators.inputs: Same panel and FIT rows/weights as logistic and candidate.
comparators.procedure: Implemented prospective scikit-learn 1.3.2 HGBClassifier, learning_rate=0.1, max_iter=100, max_leaf_nodes=31, min_samples_leaf=20, l2=0, early_stopping=False, random_state=0; no tuning.

comparators.name: context and PRE controls
comparators.inputs: Shared recording/missingness/preceding state context; PRE additionally includes pre-stimulus neural summaries.
comparators.procedure: Execute independently fixed reference recipes in each panel on the same row support and retain all results. PRE contains previous-flash carryover and is not a neural null.

nuisance_controls: Match within experiment and CHANGE/REPEAT and pre-running bin with all eight classes; disclose unsupported strata instead of changing denominator.
Preserve context-only and PRE controls because missingness, recording context and carryover can encode image information.
Keep every mouse lineage together; distinguish known image vocabulary generalization from novel class transfer.
No retrospective target-selected ROI subset, query-driven preprocessing or hidden validation tuning.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report per-mouse paired errors and descriptive mouse SE conditional on this split/shared training set. A confirmatory interval accounting for repeated images, sessions and reference execution has not been qualified; planes and presentations cannot become independent animals.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all expected case/arm files, exact generation and opaque IDs, and finite eight-probability simplex (sum tolerance 1e-6) before target access. Malformed or incomplete output invalidates the candidate; unsupported required contexts yield null full scores and retained support dispositions.

implementation.scorer_target: Probability-artifact correctness against actual withheld per-presentation image labels, with class/experiment/mouse aggregation. This is genuine stimulus decoding if authenticated labels and neural-derived features are supplied; it is not source-paper score reconstruction.
implementation.delivered_scope: Complete source recipes for the population-summary condition and two-phase F/I orchestration; public README explicitly labels the archive inactive and incomplete. No authentic projection, fitted predictor, scorer result or sandbox qualification is supplied.
missing: Authenticate full cohort identity and every NWB payload, reproduce event support and numerical features, and retain complete source census.
Execute and independently check both fixed references with exact dependencies and consistent fitting resources.
Qualify protected FIT/INFER execution; neither source pins nor signed admission syntax establish isolation.
Implement a separate direct/viewer or live per-case investigative transport before attributing performance to those modes.
implementation.execution_evidence: Reviewed source and frozen recipes only in this revision. The archive expressly reports no authentic-data check, fit, prediction, scientific score or container execution.

direct_observation.representation: Potential no-tools presentation of the fixed numeric features and permitted labeled examples; no such participant transport exists.
direct_observation.boundary: Keep class-label context fixed, hide query labels and preserve every case; a reduced feature or image-only view would be a separately specified condition.
missing: Define finite direct observation/context and complete response collection; test authentic payload delivery.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential plots of the same population summaries through typed rendering actions; no renderer or restricted viewer is included.
typed_viewer.boundary: Any renderer must preserve the exact feature information and block raw target/source metadata; no single-cell trace claim.
missing: Implement matched rendering, typed action budget and response identity binding.

tool_assisted.representation: Existing I is a precommitted script that may adapt only during FIT using training mice; INFER is fixed sealed-state prediction.
tool_assisted.boundary: A live per-query investigator would require a new matched input/tool/compute contract; its scores cannot be inferred from I-script outcomes.
missing: Deliver an actual case-adaptive numerical/model tool interaction and auditable per-case state reset.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted FIT script writes sealed state; fresh INFER predicts all query rows from that state.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze both script and training/adaptation recipe before programme input; no protected validation/test labels, cross-case state, network or feedback.
missing: Authenticate data, environments and full resource envelope; demonstrate isolation and complete source-derived grading.

evidence.supports: Preserved registered scientific question and source provenance before this revision.
Inactive full source archive, declared population/split, no authentic-data, numerical or runtime qualification.
Known-image class vocabulary, summary representation, matching hierarchy and scope limitations.
I adapts within FIT only; INFER has no training labels, live agent or feedback channel.
Native-clock dF/F population summaries, running/pupil units, exclusion census and missingness.
Complete identities/eight-way probabilities validated before target opening.
Mouse-macro CHANGE/POST balanced accuracy; null support, descriptive contrasts and no qualified gain ranking.
Fixed train-only logistic/HGB references, scikit-learn 1.3.2 and sealed FIT/INFER state.

evidence.locator: Visual Behavior Optical Physiology datasets, 2-photon imaging during behavior, and v1.1.0 changelog; checked 2026-11-16
evidence.supports: Official source defines repeated mouse imaging, image changes and omissions, NWB dF/F, and aligned behavior. Published imaging planes and repeated cells are nested observations, not independent mice.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: These source archives do not report a neural solver pilot for this task. The four historical neural programme attempts concern NEURAL-007/077; they do not qualify this task or any direct/viewer condition.
excluded_claims: Direct neural understanding or live investigation from F/I script scores.
Novel image-class generalization, unique visual information or causal image effects.

summary: Bind the authoritative target to closed-vocabulary population-summary decoding instead of general optical-neural interpretation.
Correct the F/I access taxonomy: I adapts at FIT only and supplies no live per-case investigator.
Retain independently fixed references, matched-support denominators and descriptive rather than qualified neural-increment contrasts.
revision.source_review: Inspected the preserved task and the named current implementation, preparation and scoring source. Checked the official AllenSDK dataset documentation; did not open authentic neural/behavioral payloads or run scientific stages.
